meta.title: Mandatory T&Cs must be accepted by vendors before submitting bids
gaps: Configure the event-level T&Cs as mandatory and mark every clause as required using a dedicated catalog step
warnings: resolved: “Accept every individual mandatory T&C checkbox in the vendor portal” — switch_portal / vendor_open_event open the supplier portal as the invited QA vendor in a second browser
can only test part of this — no step for: Configure the event-level T&Cs as mandatory and mark every clause as required using a dedicated catalog step

steps.note: Start a multi-stage event creation flow.
Provide the required event title before publishing.
Create an RFQ event rather than the default auction stage.
Apply an RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add the product that the vendor will quote.

args.goal: open Edit Terms and Conditions, mark all event-level terms and conditions as mandatory, click Done, and stop on the RFQ create screen showing the saved mandatory configuration

steps.note: Configure the buyer-side mandatory T&C setting, which has no dedicated domain step.
Add a participating vendor before publishing.
Publish the event with the mandatory T&C configuration.
Verify the event reached a published project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier-portal session.
Open the event's RFQ bid sheet as the vendor.
Verify the vendor's bid is refused while mandatory T&Cs remain unaccepted.

args.need: tick every mandatory T&C checkbox in the already-open vendor bid sheet without changing the bid price

steps.note: The catalog cannot identify and accept every individual vendor-side clause.
Submit the bid after the mandatory terms have been accepted.
Verify the vendor portal reports the bid as submitted.
